column2: [intro]
In my life, I have searched for the instrument,
But I have found no contentment.
The guitar was too complicated,
The piano, I grew tired of it.
No instrument can captivate me,
I prefer to sing and have fun.
No need for notes to be happy,
I am a somewhat lazy singer.
The drums were far too loud,
And the violin, what a gallant instrument!
But me, I prefer my vocal cords,
Singing everywhere, even in the bathroom.
No instrument can captivate me,
I prefer to sing and have fun.
No need for notes to be happy,
I am a somewhat lazy singer.
[ solo ]
So sing with me, everyone in chorus,
We only need happiness.
No instrument can hold us back,
Only music can entertain us.
[outro]
